function.name: edit_file
function.description: Apply changes to a file using the OpenAI patch format

path.description: Path to the file relative to project root

diff.description:
Patch in OpenAI format:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: path/to/new/file
+content line 1
+content line 2
*** End Patch

For editing existing files:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: path/to/file
@@
 context line
-removed line
+added line
*** End Patch

function.name: feature_complete
function.description: Call this ONLY when all behaviors from the task description are covered by passing tests and no more failing tests can be added. This ends the TDD session.

summary.description: List of behaviors that are now covered

function.name: done
function.description: Call this when your task is complete and no more actions are needed.

summary.description: Brief summary of what was done
